    <div class="news-desc">
      Ordered logit assumes too much; plain random forests give you no inference. <em>Ordered correlation forest</em>, <strong>now in Econometric Reviews</strong>, splits the difference&mdash;a forest built for ordered outcomes that hands you predictions and marginal effects with valid confidence intervals.
    </div>
    <div class="paper-actions">
